title: C3X on a linear chain, restricted gate set

prompt.shared_preamble: Write a single Python file using Qiskit 2.x (qiskit only) that defines exactly these 7 functions. Each returns a qiskit.QuantumCircuit with NO measurements and NO classical bits. Use Qiskit's little-endian convention (qubit 0 is the least significant bit). Do NOT use library algorithm circuits (no QFT/QFTGate, PhaseEstimation, GroverOperator, arithmetic library circuits, UnitaryGate, Isometry, StatePreparation, initialize, or Permutation gates) — build from standard gates. Correctness is checked exactly (up to global phase), so be precise.
prompt.task: 4. build_c3x_linear(): 4 qubits. Exact 3-controlled X with controls q0,q1,q2 and target q3. Allowed gates ONLY: cx, h, x, s, sdg, t, tdg, rz, p. Every cx must act on adjacent qubits only (q0-q1, q1-q2, q2-q3), either direction. No extra qubits.
prompt.shared_suffix: Return only one code block with the full file.

reference.verified_against: unitary == 16x16 permutation from the exhaustive truth table (exact, incl. phase)
reference.note: references may use library gates (they are trusted, not graded)

correctness: unitary equality up to global phase, every input (formal proof)
